{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq (descending) to make sure highest sample_seq comes first
df_sorted = df.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])

# Drop duplicates on patient_id, keeping the first (highest sample_seq) row
df_dedup = df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Compute response rate by site
response_rate_by_site = df_dedup.groupby('site')['responded'].mean().round(4)

# Print the response rates by site
print(response_rate_by_site)

# Print the site with the highest response rate
print("Site with highest response rate:", response_rate_by_site.idxmax())

# Print the highest response rate
print("Highest response rate:", response_rate_by_site.max())"}
